items.name: Unexecuted order book (including L1 positions), May 2026
items.claim: KEC International's current unexecuted order book, including L1 positions, was over Rs.40,000 crore, and as of around May 26, 2026 the order book (including L1 positions) stood at over Rs.40,000 crore with the power T&D segment clearly dominating.
items.source_excerpt: KEC International Ltd said that its current unexecuted order book, including L1 positions, was over Rs.40,000 crore. In an investor presentation, KEC International Ltd said that its order book (including L1 positions), as of around May 26, 2026, stood at over Rs.40,000 crore with the power T&D segment clearly dominating.
